title: 送还皮笔记本  (Returning the Notebook)

segments.t: Qing climbs up to the attic door to return Hao's forgotten leather notebook, trying hard to sound normal despite thinking he inspects hotels for a living. Listen first.
打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
'Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.'
啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
'Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.'
您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
'You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.'
这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
'All my street notes from this week are inside—thanks to you.'
很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
'We are glad our quiet courtyard suits your... work.'
非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
'Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?'
听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
'I heard it! It sounded like the hot-water pipe in the bathroom next door.'
我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
'I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.'
啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
'Oh! Old water pipes sometimes get a little air bubble at night.'
我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
'I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.'
谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
'Thank you for being so understanding! Chen will check the basement right away.'
晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
'Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.'

Hao got his notebook back without suspecting a thing, yet that cooling bathroom hot-water pipe is a warning sign. One final scene in Episode 3—down to the basement. See you next time.
晚安，明天见！
